title: Small Business Set-Aside for Tandemloc Brand Shock Isolators per attachments
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NAVAL SURFACE WARFARE CENTER
description_text: This procurement is a Small Business Set Aside. Email quotes on (on your companies letterhead with full specifications) to morgan.d.simo.civ@us.navy.mil on or before the closing date and time of Thursday 30 April 2026 11am Central Time. The Government will not accept late quotes. The Government will not accept quotes that are partial or incomplete. Provide cage code and Lead time on your quote. Be able to invoice through Wide Area Workflow (WAWF). The Terms are NET 30 Days. IF shipping is not included in the price please include a line item for shipping. See the attached document for the product description and quantity. Award will be based on the best value to the government considering price, delivery, quality, and past performance. Please review all attachments.
